offering_description.value: Provides domestic, expedited and international freight shipping and truckload services for businesses. It delivers domestic less-than-truckload freight door to door through its nationwide service-center network.

quotes.quote: Old Dominion Freight Line offers domestic, expedited, global and truckload services.

OD's network of more than 260 Service Centers helps you manage your domestic LTL freight needs with confidence from coast to coast. Our nationwide coverage provides direct transit from door-to-door with reduced freight handling and some of the fastest transit times in the industry.

primary_services.value: standard and expedited less-than-truckload shipping; international ocean and air shipping; container drayage; truckload brokerage; specialized freight delivery

quotes.quote: Old Dominion Freight Line offers domestic, expedited, global and truckload services.
Get reliable and efficient truckload services across North America. OD Truckload Brokerage offers dry van, flatbed, refrigerated equipment as well as solutions for special projects.

customer_segment.value: B2B: business shippers, including companies delivering product launches and seasonal promotions to retailers

quotes.quote: From Standard to Expedited LTL and everything in between, we offer a range of freight transportation services for businesses across the United States, Canada, Mexico, and beyond. Each OD service is backed by our on-time, damage-free promise.
Our Special Rollouts service delivers product launches or seasonal promotions to retailers on time and without damage, so you can be confident you’ll have a successful product rollout.
